horses.incident_text: Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.

On jumping made contact with the left side of its starting gate.  Approaching the 250 Metres improved to the inside of WINNING NOW (C L Chau) when that runner was commencing to shift in, resulting in GENIUS BABY then being crowded for room near the 250 Metres and racing tight to the inside of WINNING NOW for some distance thereafter.  C L Chau was reprimanded.  When questioned regarding his riding on the Home Turn and in the early stages of the Home Straight K Teetan stated that after following WINNING NOW into the Home Straight he attempted to improve to that runner’s inside as he felt WINNING NOW would shift out on the Home Turn and WIN METHOD was positioned directly to his outside.  He said after shifting to the inside of WINNING NOW that runner then shifted in as he attempted to obtain this run which resulted in GENIUS BABY not being able to obtain clear running for some distance after the 250 Metres.  After considering his explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Teetan were reasonable in the circumstances.  Sent for sampling post-race.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres raced tight between WAVE GARDEN and BASIC INSTINCT.  A Atzeni reported that from the outside barrier his instructions were to ride the horse conservatively in the early stages and allow it to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  Trainer M Newnham confirmed the instructions issued.  Noted to have blood in the mouth after the race.

M Chadwick reported that from a wide barrier he was obliged to make use of his mount in the early stages to race outside the lead.  He said as a consequence in the Home Straight his mount was unable to finish the race off strongly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Approaching the 200 Metres was held up for clear running when crowded between ABSOLUTE LUCKY which was racing tight to the inside of WAVE GARDEN and SIR CHARGE which shifted out when giving ground.  As a result BASIC INSTINCT was held up for clear running between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  In the early stages raced ungenerously and making the first turn got its head up when being crossed by FREE PONY.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Jumped only fairly.

Shortly after the start made contact with DASH which shifted in.  H Bowman stated that his mount over-raced throughout the early and middle stages.  He said near the 450 Metres his mount made contact with FREE PONY when that runner improved quickly to his outside which resulted in SIR CHARGE being held up behind WIN METHOD.  He added that in the Home Straight SIR CHARGE did not respond to his riding and, in his opinion, was still disappointing.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SIR CHARGE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped on jumping.  Near the 1500 Metres, STERLING WONGCHOY, which was racing keenly, was steadied to avoid LOADED WITH FLUKE (R Kingscote) which shifted in and away from VIVA CHALEUR.  Whilst the Stewards accepted that R Kingscote had made some effort to correct his mount he was advised to exercise more care.  Near the 100 Metres brushed with APOLAR FIGHTER when that runner shifted in slightly.  As a result STERLING WONGCHOY then shifted in and away from APOLAR FIGHTER and made contact with COURIER MAGIC.  H Bowman was questioned in relation to his right arm extending out and away from his body over the concluding stages which resulted in it being placed near the head of COURIER MAGIC.  H Bowman explained that he was riding his mount out in his usual manner during that stage of the race and was gathering his reins at this point which resulted in his right arm extending out and away from his body.  He added towards the finish of the event his actions did not change although he did concede his right arm was positioned close to the head of COURIER MAGIC.  Z Purton, rider of COURIER MAGIC, stated that he was not aware this incident occurred during the running of the race.  After considering his evidence the Stewards accepted the explanation of Jockey Bowman that he did not intentionally place his right arm in the vicinity of  COURIER MAGIC, however, he was advised to ensure that, wherever possible, his arm does not make contact with another horse during the running of the race.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Near the 1400 Metres commenced to race keenly and was steadied away from APOLAR FIGHTER.  Bumped near the 100 Metres.  Z Purton reported that his mount lay out throughout the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
No report.
On jumping was crowded by FOREMOST TEDDY which shifted out.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
No report.

Shifted out at the start and made contact with SMASHING EXPRESS.  Near the 350 Metres blundered when briefly crowded for room between BEAUTY MISSILE and COURIER MAGIC which lay out.  Apprentice P N Wong stated that the instructions were to go forward.  She said her mount failed to show sufficient pace in the early stages to do so which resulted in it settling further back in the field before being unable to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

When questioned Y L Chung stated that his instructions were to attempt to find a position midfield with cover.  He said from the outside barrier VIVA CHALEUR jumped well and as a result was able to hold a forward position in the early stages.  He added that with blinkers being applied for the first time VIVA CHALEUR over-raced throughout the early stages which resulted in the horse improving to the lead.  He further stated that although he was aware that the sectional times were being run inside of standard time he was unable to set a more sustainable pace as VIVA CHALEUR was racing too keenly and would not respond to his efforts to come back.  He said due to its racing manners VIVA CHALEUR weakened in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have an epiglottic entrapment.
No report.

L Ferraris stated that the instructions were to go forward.  He said when DECRELOT did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to do so it settled back in the field.  He added that throughout the event DECRELOT appeared to be displaying a respiratory issue and as a consequence when not in a competitive position in the Home Straight he did not ride it out to the finish of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of DECRELOT, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DECRELOT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Shortly after the start was bumped heavily when crowded by CLUB ACE which shifted in abruptly despite the efforts of its rider.  As a result PODIUM was taken in and made contact with ORIENTAL SURPRISE.  C L Chau pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference after the 150 Metres (see SHOTGUN).  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped on the hindquarters shortly after the start. H Bowman was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 220 Metres. Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 300 Metres was shifted to the outside of CLUB ACE to improve and as a result made contact with ORIENTAL SURPRISE.  Approaching the 200 Metres shifted out and away from CLUB ACE and again made contact with ORIENTAL SURPRISE.

Shortly after the start blundered and then shifted out and away from SONIC  BOOM, resulting in LUCKY GENERATIONS being checked to avoid TELECOM POWER when it made contact with the hindquarters of TELECOM POWER.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Shortly after the start became badly unbalanced when bumped heavily by PODIUM.  Near the 300 Metres was bumped by SONIC BOOM and taken wider.  Bumped near the 200 Metres.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
A Atzeni was found guilty of a careless riding charge for causing interference leaving the 150 Metres (see RUN RUN TIMING).  Noted to have sustained a cut to its left hind leg after the race.

B Avdulla reported that his mount hung in throughout the event and shortly after the start he was obliged to correct CLUB ACE when it shifted in abruptly.  He added that again near the 150 Metres CLUB ACE shifted in which required him to stop riding and straighten his mount at that point.
Severely checked after the 150 Metres (see SHOTGUN).  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly and then was checked when crowded by CLUB ACE which shifted in abruptly despite the efforts of its rider B Avdulla.  C L Chau (PODIUM) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that after the 150 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of SUPER ELITE, resulting in LEGEND STAR being taken in onto SHOTGUN, contributing to both LEGEND STAR and SHOTGUN being severely checked.   C L Chau was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Sunday, 14 December 2025 at Sha Tin.  In addition, C L Chau was fined $50,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his neutral race riding record.  In this incident J Orman’s left foot was dislodged from his stirrup.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A Atzeni (SUPER ELITE) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that leaving the 150 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in, crowding the running of LEGEND STAR, taking that runner across the running of RUN RUN TIMING, resulting in RUN RUN TIMING having to be checked and also contributing to SHOTGUN and LEGEND STAR being severely checked.  A Atzeni was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 3 December 2025 at Happy Valley.  In addition, Jockey Atzeni was fined $55,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, RUN RUN TIMING will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly.  K Teetan stated that from a wide barrier his instructions were to ride his mount in a conservative manner in the early stages.  He said COSMO NAVIGATOR failed to travel throughout the event and did not run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, COSMO NAVIGATOR will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.

On jumping was bumped on the hindquarters.  Apprentice E C W Wong pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference approaching the 100 Metres (see KOLACHI).  Raced wide and without cover until near the 800 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Prior to declaring weighed-in the Stewards gave consideration if there were grounds for a protest/objection against RAGGA BOMB being declared second placegetter due to interference approaching the 100 Metres.  Having regard to the margin of a length and a half between the two horses at the finish of the event the Stewards declined to lodge a protest/objection and declared weighed-in on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.  Apprentice E C W Wong (RAGGA BOMB) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the 100 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of KOLACHI, resulting in KOLACHI having to be checked.   Apprentice Wong was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 10 December 2025 and to expire on Monday, 15 December 2025 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  M F Poon pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference over the concluding stages (see HAPPY BUDDIES).  Noted to have lost its right hind plate after the race.
Jumped only fairly and shortly afterwards was crowded between CALIFORNIA MOXIE and HAPPY BUDDIES which shifted out.

Bumped shortly after the start.  Approaching the 350 Metres CALIFORNIA MOXIE, which was held up behind COLOURFUL KNIGHT, then improved to the inside of COLOURFUL KNIGHT when that runner shifted out slightly and commenced to give ground.  When COLOURFUL KNIGHT was corrected by its rider, CALIFORNIA MOXIE was checked when disappointed for clear running and as a result shifted in, crowding ABSOLUTE AWAKENED which was also checked.  The Stewards were satisfied that Jockey Bowman had not attempted to improve into a position where there was not sufficient room and that CALIFORNIA MOXIE had improved to the inside of COLOURFUL KNIGHT due to that runner giving ground.  No action was taken.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with the hindquarters of RAGGA BOMB and as a result lost ground.  ABSOLUTE AWAKENED was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 350 Metres was crowded by CALIFORNIA MOXIE and was checked.
Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event and hung out in the middle stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Raced keenly in the early stages and for some distance after the 1200 Metres was steadied away from EXCEL WONGCHOY.  M F Poon (METAL KING) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that over the concluding stages he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of HAPPY BUDDIES, resulting in HAPPY BUDDIES having to be checked.  M F Poon was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 3 December 2025 at Happy Valley.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record.
Shortly after the start was crowded by COLOURFUL KNIGHT which shifted out.  Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 900 Metres shifted out to avoid the heels of CALIFORNIA MOXIE.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, EXCEL WONGCHOY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.

On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by QUICK MONEY which shifted in.  Shortly after the start was then steadied when crowded between STAR PERFORMER and CALL TO COMMAND which shifted in whilst being corrected by its rider L Hewitson.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Briefly held up near the 200 Metres when being shifted to the outside of HARMONY FIRE.
No report.
L Hewitson stated that his mount raced greenly throughout the event and proved difficult to ride out in the Home Straight.
On jumping shifted in and made contact with the right side of its starting gate and lost ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with HEROIC MASTER.  Could not be ridden out over the final 50 Metres when held up behind STAR PERFORMER.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  QUICK MONEY then raced tight to the inside of CALL TO COMMAND for a short distance after the start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 200 Metres was hampered when taken wider by LOVING VIBES which, after shifting to the outside of HARMONY FIRE, was taken out slightly by HARMONY FIRE.  M F Poon was found guilty of a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 100 Metres (see HEROIC MASTER).  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Bumped on the hindquarters on jumping.  Lay out making the Home Turn and blundered near the 300 Metres.  M F Poon (WINNING MACHINE) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 100 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of HEROIC MASTER, resulting in HEROIC MASTER having to be checked to avoid WINNING MACHINE.  M F Poon was fined the sum of $45,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 1 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Making the first turn shifted out and away from WINNING MACHINE and as a result made the first turn wider.  THOUSAND CUPS was then obliged to race very wide and without cover thereafter.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
No report.

Raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages and for some distance after the 700 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from FORTUNE WARRIOR.  Near the 300 Metres was shifted to the outside of FORTUNE WARRIOR to obtain clear running and as a result made contact with EXCEED THE WISH.

After travelling a short distance was steadied when crowded between YOUNG STRIKER which was taken out by EXCEED THE WISH and HEALTHY HEALTHY which shifted in slightly.  Near the 700 Metres made contact with FORTUNE WARRIOR when both runners contested a position behind HEALTHY HEALTHY.  Lay in in the Home Straight.

R Kingscote stated that after holding an on-pace position, when SAVVY TWINKLE improved to his outside leaving the 500 Metres, his mount came under pressure before finishing the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, NEBRASKAN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped awkwardly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Bumped near the 300 Metres on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.  L Hewitson stated that his mount travelled well during the race but did not quicken when asked for an effort in the Home Straight.  He added that, in his view, the horse may be better suited by having the hood removed for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped at the start.
Jumped only fairly.  Near the 600 Metres made contact with the running rail.

Near the 700 Metres made contact with WINNING CHAMPION when both runners contested a position behind HEALTHY HEALTHY.  Passing the 300 Metres raced tight between LAKESHORE HERO and WINNING CHAMPION which lay in.
Approaching the 1000 Metres was steadied when crowded between EXCEED THE WISH which shifted out and away from VON BAER and WINNING CHAMPION which shifted in slightly.
Sent for sampling post-race.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  In the Home Straight lay in and proved reluctant in the early stages of the Home Straight to shift to the outside of GLORIOUS JOURNEY.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped on jumping.
Bumped on jumping.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Bumped heavily with SUNDAY’S SERENADE on jumping.  H Bowman reported that the intention was to hold a midfield position.  He said when WUKONG JEWELLERY jumped well and raced keenly in the early stages it settled more forward than what had been intended.  He added that in the Home Straight WUKONG JEWELLERY finished the race off only fairly.
No report.
Sent for sampling post-race.

On jumping bumped heavily with WUKONG JEWELLERY.  Over the final 150 Metres was held up for clear running behind INCREDIBLE MOMENT and could not be ridden out to the finish of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 1300 Metres shifted out when being crossed by WUKONG JEWELLERY.  A Atzeni reported that his mount raced keenly throughout the event and as a consequence did not run on when placed under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Withdrawn by order of the Stewards when it became fractious and refused to enter the Parade Ring.  Before being allowed to race again at Happy Valley, LUCKY KING will be required to undertake a parade test at Happy Valley Racecourse.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start made contact with ALSONSO, became unbalanced and lost ground.
Lay out making the Home Turn and in the Home Straight.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Shifted out at the start and bumped CAPTAIN LINK.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Bumped on the first turn.  Z Purton reported that his mount settled back in the field and finished the race off in a satisfactory manner.  He added that, in his opinion, CHEAHA is better suited by being stepped up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, CHEAHA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Bumped shortly after the start.  A Badel reported that the intention was to hold an on-pace position but not lead.  He said in the early stages ALSONSO, which was racing in blinkers for the first time, raced keenly and as a result led the event.  He added that he attributed tonight’s disappointing performance to the fact that ALSONSO was not suited by racing in the lead.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Jumped only fairly and was then bumped by GOKO WIN which shifted out.  Making the first turn shifted out and made contact with CHEAHA.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded between FANTASTIC FUN and OUTGATE, both of which shifted ground slightly.  Near the 350 Metres was steadied to avoid SOLID WIN when held up behind that runner.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced keenly in the middle stages and near the 1000 Metres was steadied away from ANOTHER ZONDA.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
No report.
After the 150 Metres was shifted to the inside of ANOTHER ZONDA to continue into clear running.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly and then bumped with HIGHLAND RAHY.
Between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres was held up for clear running.
Shifted in at the start and was bumped on the hindquarters.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped at the start.  H Bowman reported that the intention was to hold a forward position and to increase the tempo from along the Back Straight.  He said with the early stages of the event being run inside of standard time HIGHLAND RAHY was disadvantaged by holding its forward position and as a consequence gave ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Apprentice E C W Wong reported that his mount was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event and this was the reason why it gave ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have a respiratory condition requiring further assessment.
